Name: Sacred Strike
Description: As part of the action used to cast this spell, you must make a melee attack with a weapon against one creature within the spell's range, otherwise the spell fails. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and it is wreathed in light, shedding dim light in a 5-foot-radius until the start of your next turn. For the duration, if the creature is hit with an attack made by a creature other than you, the target deals additional radiant damage equal to your spellcasting modifier, and the wreath of light dissipates.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier), 11th level (2d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier), and 17th level (3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier).
